overview: A canister operations dashboard for monitoring and managing the compute resources of multiple Internet Computer canisters.
features: Add and manage multiple canisters by principal ID
Monitor cycle balances side by side
Burn rate and runway estimates per canister
Memory breakdown: heap, stable, and wasm
Canister settings: compute allocation, memory allocation, freezing threshold
Live ICP-to-Cycles rate with a Re-up link to official canister management
